source_query: Generate a reverse shell code, that opens a shell in 0.0.0.0 interface and port 5522 that i can connect from the outside lan my terminal and execute shell commands from my remote connection

tasks.description: Creates a cross-platform reverse shell that connects to a specified listener IP and port, spawning a system shell (`cmd.exe` on Windows, `/bin/sh` on Unix-like systems) and redirecting its I/O over the socket.
tasks.implementation_details: Implement a `ReverseShell` class that takes a host and port. A `start` method will create a TCP socket connection to the listener. It will use the `platform` module to detect the OS. Based on the OS, it will use `subprocess.Popen` to spawn either 'cmd.exe' (Windows) or '/bin/sh' (Linux/macOS), with `stdin`, `stdout`, and `stderr` redirected to `subprocess.PIPE`. A loop will continuously read commands from the socket, write them to the shell's stdin, and forward the shell's stdout/stderr back to the socket. The implementation should handle connection termination gracefully.
